known_issues.issue: The HTML sandbox's processor visualization JavaScript appears to contain invalid identifiers/assignments in drawPipeline (e.g. iota/undefined y assignment); browser execution must be tested and repaired.
The HTML demo's browser-side pulse logic differs from tnrl_core.py: it does not implement the same cross-polarity and mirror routing. Results are not comparable until behavior is unified.
The five transforms in tnrl_core.py are toy numerical transforms; they do not yet implement real source compilation, Mishnah derivation, interpretation rules, or adjudication.
The 1,044 reserved units are assigned by deterministic ID order, not by a documented control-plane partition.
Processor assignment is derived from coordinate arithmetic; no formally justified mapping from node positions to P1-P5 is documented.
The count of 21 operators is specified, but operator signatures, preconditions, and output types require a formal schema.
No benchmark harness, golden test cases, or baseline comparison against existing neural systems has yet been demonstrated.
A live website URL for the sandbox has not been confirmed; the Library index.html is a source artifact, not proof of deployment.
WANGA integration and Chrome Canary/CDP inspection are planned, not completed.
External repository README templates must not be treated as runnable project code or scientific validation.

next_steps: Keep C001 immutable; create C002 implementation branch/copy.
Run syntax checks and browser-console tests on index.html; fix visualization and ensure no global-variable errors.
Build a single shared execution contract so HTML and Python runtimes produce the same trace for the same seed.
Define formal JSON Schema for Fractal IR and 21 operators.
Implement source-preserving P1 and deterministic P2 before semantic P3-P5.
Add tests for each of the five programs, provenance preservation, nested IR, invalid transitions, and dispute branches.
Define a corpus of source-backed cases and expected outputs; only claim doctrinal correctness where a source and derivation are recorded.
Benchmark against a conventional LLM baseline and an existing multi-agent orchestrator using identical tasks, sources, and scoring.
Confirm the target WANGA website/endpoint and deploy location before claiming the sandbox is live.
At each 3-4 substantial milestones, append a new versioned context seed and changelog; never overwrite older seeds.
